title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-Based Personalized Exercise Coaching for Patients With Breast Cancer
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Provision of written and dated informed consent.
2. Female participants aged 18 to 70 years.
3. Pathologically confirmed breast malignancy.
4. Completion of major cancer treatment, including surgery, chemotherapy, and/or radiotherapy, with clinically stable disease.
5. No severe cardiopulmonary dysfunction or contraindications to exercise.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Have not undergone breast cancer surgery.
2. Mental or psychological condition, as judged by the investigator, that would prevent adherence to the intervention or completion of follow-up.
